body:
PR115's first B3 recourse was INFEASIBLE after 1433.581 s, but its certificate was rejected and the source master vector was not persisted. This change retains the joint route/mode ↔ P/Q/SOC/grid Benders architecture and supplies native mixed-sense recourse, native bounds, exact bound-supported certificates, independent replay, and a preregistered Phase-I fallback.

All 1,536 inherited assignments agree across original native LP, V1 canonical LP, V2 LP, Phase-I, monolithic MILP and V2 Benders. Native Farkas certificates validate for 1,248 infeasible assignments; 239 rejected native inputs remain archived and are certified with Phase-I. All 49 feasible assignments survive every valid cut. N1–N10 numerical checks pass, including deliberate rejection of the 5e-9 near-zero margin. Full/B3 actual native matrix construction matches original rows, senses, bounds and objective without optimization.

The historical first x cannot be restored from available PR115 evidence. No new master candidate was substituted. Same-x recourse, full B3, full M1 canary and production remain NOT_RUN; full-scale cuts are zero and B3 is INCONCLUSIVE. No performance speedup or new global LB is claimed. P1/M1 acceptance and Problem 13 validation remain false. P2/A2/M2 require separate user approval.

Validation: 789 tests pass (708 inherited + 81 new); inherited 44 bounded checks and all 1,615 base tracked files preserve their exact bytes. Source/evidence hashes and git diff --check pass. Includes raw journals/logs, rejected inputs, gate receipts, numerical audits, and 60 Korean Q&A entries. Exact base: 089518b08d477777b154d9c75dc6ea72c14f254e.
title: V42 Benders V2: native recourse certificates and Phase-I fallback
